runtime.scope: family-owned candidate-local Python under the ignored dedicated Portable

time.normalization: render each raw integer as a timezone-naive broker wall clock, localize to Europe/Helsinki with ambiguous/nonexistent failure, then convert to true UTC
time.bar_progression: only the next chronologically observed same-symbol H4 bar is used; no weekend, holiday or gap row is synthesized
time.maturation: entry bar plus 479 following observed same-symbol H4 bars must all remain before the current judged-period end

signal.features: ATR20 and prior Donchian entry/exit channels are computed from completed Bid OHLC only
signal.entry: strict decision-close breakout, execution at next observed H4 open

portfolio_event_order: settle all previously scheduled current-open exits in frozen symbol order
snapshot actual closed balance and existing original-stop reservations once
rank and reserve eligible entries sequentially
evaluate intrabar hard stops in frozen symbol order
schedule a newly completed opposite-channel condition for the next observed same-symbol open

risk.sizing_balance: the actual-balance timestamp snapshot; stressed balance never controls admission or size

execution.quotes: Bid OHLC plus row spread times point for Ask
execution.long: entry Ask; stop and market exit on Bid
execution.short: entry Bid; stop and market exit on Ask
execution.hard_stop: exact threshold and adverse-first within each held bar
execution.maximum_hold: close of held H4 bar 480; entry bar is held bar one
execution.closed_balance_drawdown: updated after each settled close in frozen cross-symbol order

economics.price_money: directional price distance divided by tick size, multiplied by profit tick value for a gain or loss tick value for a loss, then volume
economics.actual: direction-specific observed Bid/Ask price PnL plus signed swap
economics.stress: actual minus the same lifecycle's observed direction-specific spread burden once more

swap.eligible_boundaries: broker-server Monday-through-Friday midnight satisfying entry < boundary <= exit; weekend financing is represented by the frozen triple-rollover multiplier and is not charged again as synthetic Saturday/Sunday boundaries
swap.triple_day_code: MQL weekday numbering Sunday=0 through Saturday=6
swap.hard_stop_exit_time: current H4 bar-open timestamp, the deterministic intrabar lower-bound available from H4 OHLC
swap.maximum_hold_and_audit_close_time: current H4 bar open plus four hours
swap.POINTS: signed rate times point divided by tick size times trade_tick_value times volume times multiplier
swap.CURRENCY_SYMBOL: signed rate times volume times multiplier because frozen base and deposit currency are USD
swap.CURRENCY_DEPOSIT: signed rate times volume times multiplier
swap.INTEREST_CURRENT: signed percent divided by 100 times contract size times latest observed boundary reference price times volume divided by 360 times multiplier
swap.INTEREST_OPEN: signed percent divided by 100 times contract size times entry price times volume divided by 360 times multiplier

improvement_audit.population: every mature signal in both variants, whether admitted or blocked
improvement_audit.horizon_counting: entry bar is horizon bar one; exit is the selected held bar close
improvement_audit.values: one-lot raw gross, actual and stressed close R plus raw Bid MFE/MAE R
improvement_audit.broad_headroom: at 12 H4 bars both mean raw-gross R and mean stressed R must be positive with at least 10 signals in each of 2024 and 2025, both asset classes, both directions and at least four individual symbols
improvement_audit.successor_authority: audit may retain one bounded seed only and cannot execute a rescue inside V1

confirmation.condition: one unchanged highest-ranked complete development passer and byte-equal raw/durable development authority
confirmation.period_isolation: locked entries mature entirely inside 2026-01-01/2026-08-01; no 2025 entry is restored with locked rows
confirmation.capital_continuity: carry selected development actual/stressed ending balances, actual peak and maximum closed-balance drawdown into locked simulation
confirmation.native_tape: write only after locked and whole proxy gates pass

outputs.precheck: stdout only, persistent file count zero
outputs.write_policy: stage a complete no-overwrite bundle and move result last

next_authorized_action: after this exact implementation freeze reaches origin/main, run exactly one complete two-variant development bundle and mandatory improvement-potential audit
